args.title: Fix Export button stays greyed out after failed export
args.body:
File: src/components/ExportButton.tsx

The Export button stays greyed out after a failed export because the busy state is not reset when the exportReport promise rejects. To fix this, handle the error case by resetting the busy state and showing an error toast, allowing the user to click the export button again without reloading the page.
